description: A React hook that provides and automatically updates the current window's dimensions and font scale. Useful for responsive layouts and adapting UI to device orientation or screen changes.
usage:
import { useWindowDimensions } from 'react-native';

const { height, width, scale, fontScale } = useWindowDimensions();

width.description: The width in pixels of the window or screen the app currently occupies.

height.description: The height in pixels of the window or screen the app currently occupies.

scale.description: The device pixel ratio. Values are typically 1 (standard), 2 or 3 (high-density / Retina displays).

fontScale.description: The current font scaling factor applied by the user. Reflects accessibility or system-wide font size settings.

example.description: Get current window dimensions and font scale

notes: Automatically updates on screen rotation or font scaling changes.
Preferred over the static `Dimensions.get('window')` API for React components.
Values can be used directly in inline styles for responsive layouts.
